$description: LollipopChart (platform/charts/LollipopChart.jsx; library wave 9, lane C): its component tokens. Stems and dots take the chart's data-viz color (data-plx-dataviz); everything else is an existing role.

lollipop-default-color.$description: Lollipop chart: the marks' color without data-plx-dataviz (the first categorical color).

lollipop-category-width.$description: Lollipop chart, horizontal: the room before the plot for the category names (the frame's start margin).

lollipop-value-room.$description: Lollipop chart, vertical: the room above the plot, so a value label over the tallest dot is not cut.

lollipop-stem-width.$description: Lollipop chart: the stem's stroke (the chart line width).

lollipop-dot-radius.$description: Lollipop chart: the dot's radius at the value.

lollipop-dot-outline.$description: Lollipop chart: the ring around a dot in the surface color, so dots stay apart from the grid.

lollipop-dot-outline-width.$description: Lollipop chart: the dot's ring width.
